frame: Metres. x east, z = -north (three.js), y = RL in metres, Auckland 1946 MSL. Origin at the lot north-west corner.
sources: Topographical survey 1983/TO by the surveyor, 1:200, Mt Eden 2000 datum, levels in terms of LINZ MSL (Auckland 1946), as printed on RC-02 of the draft resource-consent set, issue A, 12 May 2025 ("for information only").
Proposed site plan RC-04, area plan RC-05 (1:200), proposed plans RC-06, sections RC-07, elevations RC-08 and RC-09 of the same set.
Plan model "two-units" (assembl.plan-model.v1) from Plan to 4D for walls, openings, partitions and rooms.

derivation.boundary: Computed from the surveyed bearings and distances (84°45'30" 29.26, 332°02'00" 34.22, 261°41'00" 29.76, 335°49'00" 38.62). Fitted to the printed survey: 39.36 px/m at 200 dpi (true 1:200), north rotation 0.02°, corner residuals ≤ 0.011 m. The main lot closes with a 3.05 m gap that is the access leg mouth; its area is 1,089.7 m² (title 1,143 m² includes part of the leg).
derivation.terrain: Linear interpolation of 1 m contours (52 to 44 m) traced from the survey plus 12 boundary spot levels; 0.5 m grid. Surface reproduces the spot levels within 0.13 m except 45.96 (0.29 m). Inside the existing dwelling footprint there is no survey data: interpolated.
derivation.placement: Unit footprints segmented from the building-coverage fill on RC-05 and fitted to the boundary (residuals ≤ 0.035 m). Measured 10.75 × 5.95 m and 10.72 × 5.96 m against 10.8 × 6.0 m drawn. Long axis bearing 62.0° (16C) and 61.9° (16D).
derivation.datum: Drawing RLs are on the architect's own datum. Four ground levels at boundaries on RC-07 (sections D, F, F, G) put it 456.99 m above the survey datum (sd 0.22 m). A fifth (section C, west boundary) differs by 2 m and is excluded: the survey shows a concrete wall on that boundary, so that level probably reads its foot. Requires the architect to confirm.

drawn.note: Deck extents, spa positions and stairs scaled from RC-06 (1:100 at A1, printed 1:200): source "scaled". North decks are clipped to the 1 m rear and side yards as drawn.

dtm.note: grid rows run north from z0 (north coordinate), columns east from x0; values uint16 little-endian, RL = base + v*scale

impervious.note: Impervious area (concrete driveway, turning shunt, access leg) segmented from RC-05; drawn total 295.9 m² within the site.
